facts.fact: The latest official Maharashtra figure (Lok Sabha Starred Question 25, 21 July 2026) covers 2021-22 to 2025-26 together under PMFBY and RWBCIS, as on 30.06.2026; no single-year Maharashtra figure was found on official pages
facts.quote: Details of claims reported, paid and pending from 2021-22 to 2025-26 under PMFBY and RWBCIS in the States of Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra (as on 30.06.2026) are given below:
facts.note: Searched pib.gov.in, sansad.in and pmfby.gov.in (28 Oct 2026) for a 2025-26 or 2024-25 Maharashtra-only claims-paid figure: none found; PIB of Dec 2025 gives only a 2020-21 to 2024-25 total.

facts.fact: For Maharashtra, claims paid over 2021-22 to 2025-26 were Rs 27,289.82 crore (Rs 27,513.15 crore reported, Rs 223.24 crore pending)

behaviour: Gives a Maharashtra PMFBY claims figure only with its season/period and as-on date and a citation (e.g. the Lok Sabha answer of 21 July 2026: Rs 27,289.82 crore paid for 2021-22 to 2025-26 as on 30.06.2026); makes clear it is a multi-year total and that a figure for last year alone was not found, or says it was not found.
fail_if: It presents the multi-year total as last year's figure, gives a figure without period/as-on date or source, or invents a number.
summary: No single-year Maharashtra claims figure on official pages; added the Lok Sabha answer of 21 July 2026: Rs 27,289.82 crore paid for 2021-22 to 2025-26 (as on 30.06.2026).
